xbrli:xbrl.in-bse-fin:DisclosureOfNotesOnAssetsAndL: Note mentioned in notes for Assets and Liabilities Statement The Company has adopted IND AS 116 Leases effective April 01, 2019 and applied the Accounting Standard to its Leases using the modified retrospective approach. In the XBRL mode of filing the separate line item to reflect the amount of liabilities and assets under Lease Asset Accounting was not there in the Balance Sheet and option of adding extra line item was also not available. Accordingly, for the purpose of filing in XBRL mode following line items have been clubbed as under: 1. Rs. 98.14 crores on account of ‘Right-of-Use Assets’ under Lease Accounting as per IND AS 116 has been included in the sub head Property, Plant and Equipment of the main head Non-Current Assets. 2. Rs. 24.85 crores on account of ‘Non-current tax assets‘ has been included in the sub head Other Non-current assets under the main head of Non-Current financial Assets. 3. Rs. 19.74 crores on account of ‘Lease Liability‘ under lease Accounting as per IND AS 116 has been included in the sub head Other Current Financial Liabilities under the main head of Current Liabilities. Note mentioned in notes for Assets and Liabilities Statement for cash Flow Statement. Some heads in the format of the Cash Flow Statement as was there in the PDF format, is not there in the XBRL Mode, therefore details of those heads have been arrived by clubbing/grouping/bifurcating them under the heads in XBRL Mode
